preconditions.description: The input string has length between 1 and 100,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is the omeric string, formed by concatenating the longest palindromic suffix and longest palindromic prefix of the input string.
The output consists of exactly two lines: the omeric string and the frequency counts of its prefixes.

postconditions.expression: len(frequencies) == len(omeric_string) and all(frequencies[i] == count for i, count in enumerate(frequencies))
postconditions.description: The second line contains space-separated integers representing the frequency of each prefix of the omeric string as a substring, where frequencies[i] is the count of the (i+1)-length prefix (1-based) in the omeric string.
All frequency counts are non-negative integers.
